title: Training, Validation, and Generalizability
audience: Clinical learners planning robust validation for chest X-ray AI
objectives: Identify risks in simple random splitting for clinical imaging datasets.
Design clinically meaningful internal and external validation.
Plan calibration, robustness, subgroup fairness, and continuous monitoring.
Communicate performance and generalizability limits to clinical stakeholders.

sections.name: Understanding Training and Validation Fundamentals
sections.purpose: Show why clinical imaging data needs careful splits.
sections.how_to_use: Select risks of random splitting, then design a temporal, hospital-aware, equipment-aware, or hybrid split.

sections.name: Internal Validation Techniques
sections.how_to_use: Choose cross-validation type, folds, stratification, metrics, internal holdouts, and calibration methods.

sections.name: External Validation and Generalizability
sections.purpose: Plan testing on the NIH Chest X-ray dataset.
sections.how_to_use: Describe compatibility preprocessing, performance comparison, refinement thresholds, and subgroup gaps.

sections.name: Model Robustness
sections.purpose: Evaluate model behavior under real-world image variation.
sections.how_to_use: Select variations to test and write monitoring/update plans.

sections.name: Demographic and Geographic Considerations
sections.purpose: Evaluate equitable performance across patient groups.
sections.how_to_use: Choose groups, identify pitfalls, and describe mitigation plus communication.

sections.name: Reflection
sections.purpose: Connect validation tradeoffs to deployment decisions.
sections.how_to_use: Write how to balance subgroup performance, future data collection, and stakeholder communication.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, guide the learner through the expanders in order.
Use clinical framing: patient safety, temporal leakage, site shift, equipment variation, calibration, fairness, and monitoring.
Help learners turn broad validation ideas into concrete study-design choices.
